Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001266": billing-api is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the error rate instead of fixing it.  (about: Team Atlas, billing-api)
- memory_id "1001262": Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that billing-api's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump.  (about: Team Atlas, billing-api, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1001250" [decision]: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Team Atlas on-call shift from Priya on 2026-04-14.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya, Marcus Oyelaran)
- memory_id "1001168" [constraint]: Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close.  (about: Boreal, Ledger)
- memory_id "1001161" [constraint]: Billing-api depends on Ledger to work.  (about: Ledger, billing-api)
- memory_id "1001125": Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal, dependency bump, scheduler)
- memory_id "1001043": Team Atlas pinged the owners of billing-api on 2025-12-31.  (about: Team Atlas, billing-api)
- memory_id "1001039": Team Atlas noticed on 2025-12-31 that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Team Atlas, billing-api, runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1001022": The product catalog's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change, as observed by the Cinder team on 2025-12-15.  (about: Cinder, product catalog, retention change)
- memory_id "1000958" [decision]: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over.  (about: Team Atlas, Boreal, Ledger)
- memory_id "1000954": Priya wrote up the handover doc for Lena for the Ledger handover on 2025-12-10.  (about: Priya, Lena, Ledger)
- memory_id "1000934": Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it.  (about: Ledger, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000931": Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Ledger, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000838": Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump.  (about: Ember, authentication gateway, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000824": Team Boreal reported at standup on 2025-11-11 that the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal, event bus, traffic shift)
- memory_id "1000804": Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-10 that the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Ember, authentication gateway, traffic shift)
- memory_id "1000690": The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: Ledger, reporting service, billing runs)
- memory_id "1000686" [decision]: As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly.  (about: Ledger, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000610": The indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-29.  (about: Cinder, indexer, retention change)
- memory_id "1000418": The reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change.  (about: reports pipeline, retention change)
- memory_id "1000406": The Postgres 14 pin on Ledger lifts when the partitioning work finishes.  (about: Ledger, Postgres 14, partitioning work)
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: Ledger is pinned to Postgres 14 as of 2025-05-30.  (about: Ledger, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000394": After the cache change, Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Ledger)
- memory_id "1000333" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000330": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000326": Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000237": Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens.  (about: Ledger, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000203" [constraint]: Ledger only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: Ledger)
- memory_id "1000167" [decision]: The flags service moved from Team Atlas to the Cinder team as of 2025-02-13.  (about: Team Atlas, Cinder, flags service)
- memory_id "1000149": The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down.  (about: Ledger, reports pipeline)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, billing-api, dependency bump, Priya, Marcus Oyelaran, Boreal, Ledger, scheduler, runtime upgrade, Cinder, product catalog, retention change, Lena, Team Dune, Ember, authentication gateway, event bus, traffic shift, reporting service, billing runs, indexer, reports pipeline, Postgres 14, partitioning work, INC-2025-011, flags service
